title: Pipeline stage: publish the lab front end to Amplify
description: The lab page is Amplify app cyclotron-console: static, no repository connected, auto-build off, not in any stack. Add a stage after the backend verifies that builds with amplify.yml's commands (npm --prefix trace-ui ci, npm --prefix trace-ui run build, node trace-ui/scripts/package-console.mjs) and publishes the zip of trace-ui/console-dist with amplify create-deployment and start-deployment. Never publish the Lambda's vendored bundle; it is not hosted mode. Connecting a repository to the app is the alternative if this proves awkward. Check sign-in works after the first publish.
